whatItIs: dwavebinarycsp is an open-source project in the general-purpose sdks category. It is maintained by dwavesystems and primarily looks like a Python codebase. Map constraint satisfaction problems with binary variables to binary quadratic models.

For readers mapping the ecosystem, this resource is useful because it shows how one team approaches general-purpose sdks workflows in practice. The repository README emphasizes: :warning: *dwavebinarycsp* is deprecated. For solving problems with constraints, we recommend using the hybrid solvers in the Leap :tm: service. You can find documentation for the hybrid solvers at https://docs.ocean.dwavesys.com. Library to construct a binary quadratic model from a constraint satisfaction problem with small constraints over binary variables. The repository also appears to be archival or no longer actively maintained, which matters when evaluating it for current production use.
